say:1:1830121001:1.text: Some say it was built for one of the God of Death's followers; others claim it was for Novaris' first ruler. It's all hearsay, though, so I can't say for sure.
say:1:1830121001:1.source_cn: 传闻说是死神座下的某位眷属，也有人说是诺珐斯的第一任领...
say:1:1830121001:1.male: Some say it was built for one of the God of Death's followers; others claim it was for Novaris' first ruler. It's all hearsay, though, so I can't say for sure.
say:1:1830121001:1.female: Some say it was built for one of the God of Death's followers; others claim it was for Novaris' first ruler. It's all hearsay, though, so I can't say for sure.

say:2:1830121002:1.text: No one really knows how long the statue's been here.
say:2:1830121002:1.source_cn: 毕竟过去了太久，这雕像在这里立了多少年，谁也说不清了。
say:2:1830121002:1.male: No one really knows how long the statue's been here.
say:2:1830121002:1.female: No one really knows how long the statue's been here.
